brief.t: START HERE: Walk to Ron and Aaron and ask for today's Mothered separation and viscosity results before anyone scales up.

ACT NOW 1: Mothered quality gate is due today. Michael's October 22 update says Ron and Aaron are resolving separation and viscosity, with scale-up conditional on satisfactory results October 23. This is a 1-day-old update, not an overdue test deadline. Send: Ron and Aaron, please show me today's Mothered results and confirm the acceptance criteria, QC checks and documented procedure before we agree a scale up time.

ACT NOW 2: TALOVA needs both material clarification and shipment reconciliation. Michael reported ingredients not meeting expectations yesterday; Marcello has waited 3 calendar days since October 20 for tight-window FBA labels and shipments showing unshipped. Send: Aaron, please identify the TALOVA ingredient concerns and affected batches today so I can reconcile usable inventory and give Sam verified shipment dates and tracking for his customer reply.

ACT NOW 3: Get Polo's rail appointment for EMCU8614105. Sasha's October 22 update says pending ingate because the rail yard has no available appointments; this status is 1 day old, with no promised ingate date. Do not assume it is still at the exam site or pay the exam invoice twice. Send: Sasha, please confirm the first available rail appointment, current container location and any charges accruing today, and have Erik confirm whether any payment or release conditions remain open.
